text:
tariq: Hey @finance-team, corp card was used for an airport -> hotel Lyft but I made a personal stop on the way (dropped friend at 7th St). Total charge $92.45, tip included. Driver gave a single receipt only. How do I submit for just the business portion?
laura: short answer: we only reimburse the business portion. We need either (a) an itemized vendor receipt showing each stop/fare, or (b) your bank/card statement plus a clear note with the calculation of the business split and manager approval. If you pick (b) include a time estimate and distance justification.
tariq: I only have the single receipt photo and my card charge on the bank app. No itemization. I can estimate split: business leg $63.20, personal leg $29.25. Is a handwritten note ok?
laura: handwritten note is acceptable if legible and signed, but manager approval is required for the split. Also include how you calculated it (e.g., app distance or meter reading). Tag the expense BUS-ONLY and include "split fare" in the notes.
jess: approved the business portion estimate. Confirming I saw the receipt and Tariq's note, ok to reimburse $63.20 pending formal submission. :white_check_mark:
tariq: uploaded: bank-screenshot.png, receipt-photo.jpg, handwritten-split.pdf. Created expense EXP-2024-9102 tagged BUS-ONLY. Note: "airport->hotel business $63.20, personal drop-off $29.25; manager jess approved."
expense-bot: New expense submitted by tariq  total: 92.45 USD, assigned: BUS-ONLY (63.20 USD to be reimbursed), status: awaiting processing. Expense ID: EXP-2024-9102.
laura: I will process the reimbursement for $63.20. Accounting will record a personal deduction for the $29.25 personal portion (not reimbursed). For clarity: we do not accept tips for personal portion. If accounting needs further proof we'll ping you.
tariq: thanks! I can also pull the Lyft trip history screenshot if needed, let me know.
laura: that would help but not required since manager approved. If you can add the trip history it speeds audit.
tariq: will add it now, thanks :)
